# xidm1

Formerly `xts2` (Tailscale exit-node era) — renamed and repurposed 2026-08-21 as a
Kanidm 3rd read-replica and last-resort idm VIP member on the server VLAN
(172.20.1.111/24).

## Files

- disks.nix
- default.nix
- network.nix
- minimal.nix

## File Summaries

### disks.nix
Board now boots via UEFI from SPI flash (LibreTech firmware). Layout: EFI system partition + ext4 root. No U-Boot reservation needed.

### default.nix
NixOS ARM host configuration for xidm1, imports boot and disk modules.

### network.nix
Static network configuration for xidm1 — re-IP'd onto the server VLAN (172.20.1.111/24) for Kanidm replication + idm VIP membership.

### minimal.nix
Minimal SD image configuration for xidm1; deploy with deploy-rs after boot.

## Overview

This folder contains the following files with their respective purposes summarized above.
